in_sanskrit.name: अद्विक

in_marathi.name: Advik
in_marathi.long_meaning: Advik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Advik is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘advai’ meaning ‘two’ and ‘k’ meaning ‘path’. In Hindu mythology, Advik is a name of Lord Vishnu, symbolizing the two paths of righteousness and sin that every soul must choose in life.
